rationale: Correct a misleading premise that survived in the parent account prose: it described the StopSign adjustment of the snapshot equal case as if it limited the drift, while the snapshot receipt shows the adjustment maps a request equal to the drifted decided index to the decided log without the StopSign (8) which still exceeds the content (6). The correction is recorded as a sourced fact citing that receipt so the parent prose can be repaired on the next account rewrite.

knowledge.statement: The snapshot path adjustment for a request equal to the decided index is not a protection against the witnessed drift: that case maps the request to the decided log without the StopSign, which in the observed state was 8 against content of six indices, so the resulting compacted index still exceeded the entries the replica held and the snapshot was still built from an empty range.
knowledge.conditions: Snapshot-capable entry type after the drift; derived from try_snapshot and read against the sampled state of receipt e70b8baa087246c78ea3a64f24b8e97c, where the decided index was 9 and the content six indices. No execution used a request exactly equal to the decided index.
